Chapter 7B remains the most severe because it lacks a verified personal-integrity nexus, but Chapters 1B-6B and 8B also require bounded continuation. The 1B continuation recovered several precise, independent technical and arms-control sources; remaining gaps are specific rather than a basis for saturation.
